title: Requested removals (commandment 10)
description: File: governance/removals.yaml (docs/growth.md), append-only, by the council (bee remove-data). Each removal is tied to a verifiable request: its channel, its day, and its public reference if, and only if, it was made in public. Of the person, it keeps only the fingerprints (SHA-256 of the canonical key) of what names them, never a name in plain text; it adds them to the do-not-contact list only if they asked for that too (no_contact).

passages.description: The number of passages removed, comments included: bounded by REMOVAL_TOTAL_MAX and, over 7 days, REMOVAL_WEEK_MAX (ruche-0116)

no_contact.description: They also asked not to be contacted again: the list receives the fingerprints
